verdicts.claim: Every one of the 100 duels replays to the very same receipt; its cases, laid out, give back the receipt’s two AUCs exactly; and each side calls exactly as many yeses as the batch holds real yeses.
verdicts.saw: 100 of 100 duels replayed to the very same receipt, their cases giving back its AUCs, each side calling exactly as many yeses as the batch held

verdicts.claim: On every case of every replayed duel, each fielded mind’s read-back gives the very score the duel used for it, and for every mind of one department the weights of its rules that fired sum to that score.
verdicts.saw: 19584 of 19584 read-backs gave the very score the duel used; 19584 of 19584 minds of one department had their fired rules sum to it

verdicts.claim: Across the 1,000 receipt sets every bracket plays out the same however its entrants are listed; every decided match is decided by the first receipt, in order, naming exactly its two cards that is not a draw; no match is decided while a side of it is open; a champion is named exactly when the final is decided, its title practice exactly when a deciding duel was one owner against itself; and all 5 real brackets play out to a champion that is no practice champion.
verdicts.saw: 1000 of 1000 receipt sets played out the same however entered; 1000 decided every match only by the first decisive receipt of exactly its two cards; 1000 never decided a match with a side open; 1000 named a champion exactly when the final was decided; 3 of 5 real brackets played to a champion

verdicts.claim: In at least 80% of the decided duels whose sides called different numbers of cases right, the side that called more right also has the higher AUC: the watched-back tally agrees with the receipt.
verdicts.saw: 63 of 73 decided duels whose sides called different numbers of cases right were won by the side with more right (86.3%)

verdicts.claim: In the 5 real brackets, the card with the higher declared GATE AUC wins at least 60% of the matches between cards of different declared AUC: the arena’s 64 cases reflect the score a card was proven on.
verdicts.saw: 17 of 29 bracket matches were won by the card with the higher declared GATE AUC (58.6%)
